title: Implement Early hints response status, do not poll the encoding with HTTP 1xx codes

timeline.message:
Do not poll the encoding with HTTP 1xx codes

Motivation:

Http 1xx codes should expect another response next

Modifications:

Replace code == 100 with code == 1xx

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/12904
timeline.author: Andrea Cavalli

timeline.body:
Motivation:

- 103 Early Hints response status is missing
- Http 1xx codes should expect another response next

Modifications:

- Add 103 Early Hints response status
- Replace `code == 100` with `code == 1xx`

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/12904 and https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/pull/4508

I didn't modify the http2 codec because I currently can't test it and I don't know the HTTP2 protocol very well, someone else should take a look at it.

This issue also affects netty 5, should I open another PR?

timeline.message:
Implement 1xx Informational Response codes properly

RFC7540:
An informational response using a 1xx status code other than 101 is
   transmitted as a HEADERS frame, followed by zero or more CONTINUATION
   frames.

   Trailing header fields are sent as a header block after both the
   request or response header block and all the DATA frames have been
   sent.  The HEADERS frame starting the trailers header block has the
   END_STREAM flag set.
timeline.author: Andrea Cavalli
Andrea Cavalli

timeline.body:
How about we also have a test where we skip the CONTINUE response and immediately send the early hints?
I understand their main use case are to be the first response that goes out.

reply.body:
You are right, I was testing both early hints and multiple 1xx responses in the same test.
I'll split the test in two

timeline.body:
> This issue also affects netty 5, should I open another PR?

Yeah, please make this a separate PR for Netty 5. There are enough differences between the two versions that it'd be good to get a PR build before integrating.
To avoid hardcoding constants, consider checking that `res.status().codeClass() == INFORMATIONAL`.
